senses.definition: vb. wail (? cf. Assyrian damâmu, groan, wail, lament, DlBaer’s Ezech xi; Pr 64)—only
Imv. דֹּ֫מּוּ ישְׁבֵי אִי Is 23:2 wail, ye coast dwellers (cf. Dll.c.), ‖ הֵילִילוּ v 1, & הֵילִילוּ ישְׁבֵי אִי v 6; most, however, assign this to I. דמם q.v. (3).
